# SCORE

> Free mentorship, business education, and resources connecting entrepreneurs with experienced volunteer mentors to start and grow successful small businesses.

SCORE is a nonprofit organization that has provided free small business mentoring and resources since 1964. The platform connects over 11,000 volunteer mentors with entrepreneurs at all business stages, offering personalized guidance, educational webinars, templates, and success stories to support business growth and resilience.

## Key Topics

- Small business mentoring
- Entrepreneurship
- Mentor matching
- Business planning
- Startup guidance
- Business growth

## Mentorship & Mentor Connection

- [Find a Mentor](https://www.score.org/find-mentor): Connect with 11,000 volunteer mentors for free business advice and growth
- [How It Works](https://www.score.org/find-mentor/how-it-works): Guide explaining SCORE's mentor matching and pairing process
- [Become a Mentor](https://www.score.org/volunteer/become-mentor): Guide for becoming a SCORE mentor with responsibilities and expectations

## Business Planning & Templates

- [The Startup Roadmap: Your Guide to Successfully Starting a Business](https://www.score.org/startup-roadmap): Comprehensive startup guide with planning steps and business fundamentals
- [Business Templates and Resources](https://www.score.org/templates-resources): Library of business templates for planning, finance, marketing, and operations
- [Business Planning & Financial Statements Template Gallery](https://www.score.org/templates-resources/business-planning-financial-statements-template-gallery): Downloadable templates for business plans, financials, and Business Model Canvas

## Business Education & Learning

- [Business Education Events and Webinars](https://www.score.org/business-education): SCORE's live events, webinars, and training for business education
- [Online Courses](https://www.score.org/workshops-events/online-courses): Self-paced online courses including SCORE Academy and startup guides

## Resource Hubs & Support

- [Small Business Resource Hubs](https://www.score.org/score-for-all): Resource hubs for entrepreneurs at different business stages and backgrounds
- [Small Business Resilience Hub](https://www.score.org/templates-resources/small-business-resilience-hub): Disaster recovery and crisis management resources for business resilience
- [Success Stories](https://www.score.org/success-stories-search): Searchable directory of SCORE client success stories by topic and location

## Volunteer Opportunities

- [Volunteer with SCORE](https://www.score.org/page/volunteer-score): Overview of volunteer opportunities and ways to give back with SCORE
- [Volunteer Opportunities](https://www.score.org/volunteer-opportunities): Various volunteer roles including mentoring, workshops, and subject expertise
- [Training and Onboarding](https://www.score.org/volunteer/training-and-onboarding): Volunteer onboarding process and mentor certification training requirements

## About SCORE

- [About](https://www.score.org/about): SCORE organizational overview, mission, and impact since 1964
- [Meet the Leadership Team](https://www.score.org/about/meet-leadership-team): SCORE leadership team and board of directors information

## Optional
